summary: ESS Tech, Inc. disclosed amendments to its at-the-market offering (ATM) program via an 8-K filed July 17, 2026. The changes terminate four prior sales agents (BMO, Canaccord, Needham, Stifel) and add Roth Capital Partners as a new sales agent and qualified independent underwriter. No shares are sold under this filing; it is a routine administrative update to a securities distribution agreement. No pricing, premium, or special-situation terms are present. The filing does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, tender offer, or any other special situation; it is purely a shelf-program administrative change.
